en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 465 - It is narrated from Saad bin Abdullah Ashari from Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid from Salih bin Muhammad from Hani Tammar that

Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said: “There will be occultation for the master of this affair. During this time those who remain attached to their religion will be like those who rub their hands on a thorny branch. Then he gestured and said: There is occultation for the master of this affair and every person is duty-bound to fear Allah and remain attached to his religion.”
